knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

The following code was adapted from Galloway et al. to model the 
predator-prey dynamics of Pycnopodia and urchins under various outplanting 
scenarios. The equations used in the model are: 

dU/dt = i*U*(1 - U/K) - [p*q*U*S / (1 + b*U + c*O)]
dS/dt = e * [[p*Q*U*S / (1+b*U + c_o*O)] * [(1 - U/K)^z] + p*q*O*S / (1+b*U + c_o*O)] * [S/(S+g)]

Variable -> code 
  U -> N[4]           urchin density (prey)
  S -> N[1]           sea star density (predator)
  O -> N[2] + N[3]    alternative prey (susceptible + non-susceptible)
  i -> pars$rec       fixed urchin recruitment 
  K -> pars$K_U       urchin carrying capacity (barren conditions)
  p -> pars$rho_u     predator preference for urchins
  q -> pars$alpha     predator search/attack rate 
  b -> pars$b_u       urchin saturation coefficient
  c -> pars$c_o       alternative prey saturation coefficient
  e -> pars$e         conversion efficiency of urchin biomass to Pycnopodia population growth
  g -> pars$g         Allee effect threshold parameter
  z -> pars$z         weight of nutritional impact 
  d -> pars$d         Pycnopodia mortality rate
  r -> pars$r         Growth rate for alternative prey
  K_alt -> pars$K_alt Carrying capacity for alternative prey
  exchange -> pars$exchange 
  

Load libraries  
```{r}
library(deSolve)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
```

Setting up the differential equations
```{r}
diffyq <- function(t, N, pars) {

  S <- max(N[1], 0)   # Pycnopodia density
  U <- max(N[4], 0)   # urchin density
  
  X1 <- max(N[2], 0)  # susceptible alternative prey
  X2 <- max(N[3], 0)  # non-susceptible alternative prey
  O <- X1 + X2  # total alternative prey (used in urchin equation denominator)


  # Pycnopodia dynamics--------------------------------------------------------- 
  #   birth term: e * [[p*q*U*S / (1+b*U + c_o*O)] * [(1 - U/K)^z] + (p*q*O*S / (1+b*U + c_o*O)] * [S/(S+g)]
  #   death term: d * S

  
  urchin_consumption <- (pars$rho_u * pars$alpha * U * S) / (1 + pars$b_u * U + pars$c_o * O)
  alt_consumption    <- (pars$rho_x * pars$alpha * O * S) / (1 + pars$b_u * U + pars$c_o * O)
  
  allee_effect <- S / (S + pars$g)
  nutritional_impact <- pmax(1 - U / pars$K_U, 0) ^ pars$z  # pmax prevents negative base

  birth_S <- pars$e * (urchin_consumption * nutritional_impact + alt_consumption) * allee_effect
  death_S <- pars$d * S

  dSdt <- birth_S - death_S

  # Urchin dynamics-------------------------------------------------------------
  #   growth term: i*U*(1 - U/K)
  #   predation:   p*q*U*S / (1 + b*U + c*O)
  
  growth_U   <- pars$rec * U * (1 - U / pars$K_U)
  predation_U <- (pars$rho_u * pars$alpha * U * S) / (1 + pars$b_u * U + pars$c_o * O) 

  dUdt <- growth_U - predation_U
  
  # Alternative prey -----------------------------------------------------------
 
  # Alternative prey recruitment
  recx <- pars$r * (X1 + X2) * (1 - (X1 + X2) / pars$K_alt)
  
  # Predation on alternative prey by Pycnopodia
  predation_X1 <- (pars$rho_x * pars$alpha * X1 * S) / (1 + pars$b_u * U + pars$c_o * O)
  predation_X2 <- (pars$rho_x * pars$alpha * X2 * S) / (1 + pars$b_u * U + pars$c_o * O)
  
  # Logistic growth + exchange between types - predation
  dx1dt <- 0.5* recx + pars$exchange * (X2 - X1) - predation_X1
  dx2dt <- 0.5 * recx + pars$exchange * (X1 - X2) - predation_X2


  return(list(c(dSdt, dx1dt, dx2dt, dUdt)))
}
```

Creating the parameters list 
```{r}
pars <- list(

  # Predation / functional response
  alpha  = 2.5,     # search / attack rate (Q), Galloway et al. uses alpha = 1000
  rho_u  = 1,      # preference weight for urchins (P)
  rho_x  = 1,    # preference weight for alt prey (eat alt prey half the time)
  b_u    = 0.1,   # urchin saturation coefficient (b)
  c_o    = 0.1,    # alt prey saturation coefficient (c)

  # Urchin parameters
  rec    = 1,        # fixed urchin recruitment
  K_U    = 16.65,       # urchin carrying capacity
  m      = 0.0833,     # urchin natural mortality rate

  # Pycnopodia parameters 
  e      = 0.01,        # conversion efficiency 
  g      = 0.01,       # Allee effect threshold
  z      = 0.3,        # nutritional value exponent; 1 = linear, >1 = convex penalty
  d      = 0.03,      # sea star mortality - made this up!!! 
  
  # Alternative prey parameters
  r        = 0.5,      # growth rate for alternative prey
  K_alt    = 30,       # carrying capacity for alternative prey
  exchange = 0.1      # exchange rate between susceptible and non-susceptible prey
)
```

Run functions
```{r}
run_mods <- function(P0,
                     g        = 0.01,
                     d        = 0.03,
                     z        = 0.3,
                     rec      = 1,
                     X0       = 30,
                     K_U      = 16.65,
                     Y0       = 10,  # initial urchin density 
                     ode_fun,
                     pars,
                     n_iter   = 500,
                     interval = 1) {

  # Update parameters for this run
  pars$g    <- g
  pars$d    <- d
  pars$z    <- z
  pars$K_U  <- K_U
  pars$rec  <- rec

  # Run ODE  (state order: S, X1, X2, U)
  out <- ode(
    y     = c(P0, X0, X0, Y0),
    times = seq(0, (n_iter - 1) * interval, by = interval),
    func  = ode_fun,
    parms = pars
  )

  data.frame(
    time   = out[, 1],
    pycno  = out[, 2],
    X1     = out[, 3],
    X2     = out[, 4],
    urchin = out[, 5],
    P0     = P0,
    g      = g,
    d      = d,
    z      = z
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Run scenarios
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

P0_vals <- c(0.0001, exp(seq(log(0.001), log(0.06), length.out = 18)))
g_vals  <- c(0, 0.001, 0.01, 0.03)

results <- expand.grid(P0 = P0_vals, g = g_vals) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  do(run_mods(
    P0       = .$P0,
    g        = .$g,
    ode_fun  = diffyq,
    pars = pars,
    n_iter   = 500
  )) %>%
  ungroup()

```

Plot results
```{r}

results <- results %>%
  mutate(
    P0_label = paste0("P0 = ", round(P0, 4)),
    g_label  = factor(g, labels = c("No Allee (g=0)",
                                     "Weak (g=0.001)",
                                     "Moderate (g=0.01)",
                                     "Strong (g=0.03)"))
  )

results_long <- results %>%
  select(time, pycno, urchin, P0, P0_label, g_label) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols      = c(pycno, urchin),
               names_to  = "species",
               values_to = "density") %>%
  mutate(species = recode(species,
                          "pycno"  = "Pycnopodia density",
                          "urchin" = "Purple urchin density"))

p_updated <- ggplot(results_long,
                    aes(x = time, y = density,
                        colour = P0, group = P0_label)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.8, linewidth = 0.6) +
  scale_colour_viridis_c(
    trans   = "log10",
    name    = expression(paste("Starting pycno density (", m^-2, ")")),
    breaks  = c(0.0001, 0.001, 0.01, 0.06),
    labels  = c("0.0001", "0.001", "0.01", "0.06 (historical)")
  ) +
  facet_grid(species ~ g_label, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = expression(paste("Density (no. ", m^-2, ")"))
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid       = element_blank(),
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    legend.key.width = unit(2, "cm"),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold")
  ) +
  guides(colour = guide_colourbar(title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0.5))

p_updated
```

```{r}
# Plotting alternative prey 
results_alt <- results %>%
  mutate(
    P0_label = paste0("P0 = ", round(P0, 4)),
    g_label  = factor(g, labels = c("No Allee (g=0)",
                                     "Weak (g=0.001)",
                                     "Moderate (g=0.01)",
                                     "Strong (g=0.03)"))
  ) %>%
  select(time, X1, X2, P0, P0_label, g_label) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols      = c(X1, X2),
               names_to  = "prey_type",
               values_to = "density") %>%
  mutate(prey_type = recode(prey_type,
                            "X1" = "Susceptible",
                            "X2" = "Non-susceptible"))

ggplot(results_alt,
       aes(x = time, y = density,
           colour = P0, group = P0_label)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.8, linewidth = 0.6) +
  scale_colour_viridis_c(
    trans   = "log10",
    name    = expression(paste("Starting pycno density (", m^-2, ")")),
    breaks  = c(0.0001, 0.001, 0.01, 0.06),
    labels  = c("0.0001", "0.001", "0.01", "0.06 (historical)")
  ) +
  facet_grid(prey_type ~ g_label, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Susceptible vs non-susceptible alternative prey across Allee scenarios",
    x     = "Year",
    y     = expression(paste("Density (no. ", m^-2, ")"))
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid       = element_blank(),
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    legend.key.width = unit(2, "cm"),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold")
  ) +
  guides(colour = guide_colourbar(title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0.5))
